scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix services/backend install && npm --prefix services/frontend install && npm run setup:ml
scripts.setup:ml: cd services/ml && ${PYTHON:-python3} -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ml -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix services/backend run dev" "npm --prefix services/frontend run dev" "npm run dev:ml"
